info.title: Undo local API
info.description: Local, token-protected API of the Undo daemon.

get.description: Unauthenticated liveness probe used for discovery (reveals no data).

schema.title: Response Ping Api V1 Ping Get
Response Doctor Api V1 Doctor Get
Response Shutdown Api V1 Daemon Shutdown Post
Response List Roots Api V1 Roots Get
Response Scan Api V1 Scan Post
Response Deleted Files Api V1 Files Deleted Get
Response Skipped Files Api V1 Files Skipped Get
Response Search Api V1 Files Search Get
Response Activity Api V1 History Log Get

post.description: Remove the history of a file or a folder (optionally only versions older than `before`).
Delete individual versions (not a file's latest version, not snapshot versions).

get.description: Compare a stored version with a file on disk (default: the file's current location).
Both sides for a merge editor: the file on disk now and the stored version.

post.description: Write a merged result; the file's current content is saved as a version first.

schema.title: Response Merge Drafts Api V1 Merge Drafts Get
Response Delete Merge Draft Api V1 Merge Draft Delete

put.description: Keep a finished merge with Undo; the next restore of that version writes it.

get.description: Raw content stream. Integrity is verified on restore; use restore for guaranteed copies.

schema.title: Response List Snapshots Api V1 Snapshots Get

patch.description: Rename a snapshot and/or change its description.

schema.title: Response Get Settings Api V1 Settings Get
Response Set Setting Api V1 Settings Put
Response Update Settings Api V1 Settings Patch
Response List Exclusions Api V1 Exclusions Get

DiffRow.title: DiffRow
DiffRow.description: One row of a side-by-side diff: the old line (a) next to the new line (b).

FileDiff.title: FileDiff
FileDiff.description:
A stored version compared with a file on disk: left = the file now, right = the version.

This is what a restore of ``version`` to ``path`` would change.

path.title: Path
path.description: A file (current or former path) or a folder inside a tracked root

before.title: Before
before.description: Only remove versions older than this (ISO or relative: 30d). Latest is kept.

ForgetResult.title: ForgetResult
ForgetResult.description: Result of removing history on purpose (a file, a folder, older versions, single versions).

MergeDraft.title: MergeDraft
MergeDraft.description: Saved progress of a merge, to resume later.

MergeSource.title: MergeSource
MergeSource.description: Both sides of a merge: the file on disk now (left) and a stored version (right).

expected_hash.title: Expected Hash
expected_hash.description: current_hash from merge-source; refused if the file changed since

description.title: Description
description.description: New description; empty string clears it

path.title: Path
path.description: Current or historical path of a file or directory
